title: The specified finite discrete coefficient realization is an exact equivalence
statement: Let B be a finite discrete commutative topological ring and X a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Fix a monoidal isomorphism eR from the sheafified constant lifted B-ring on profinite sets to its continuous-function condensed ring [lem-weil-pbc-finite-discrete-condensed-ring-constant]. Form the specified realization R_X from fixed-scalar B-module sheaves on X_proet to internal modules over the pulled-back condensed ring: encode its action sectionwise, sheafify monoidally, and restrict along the inverse of the pulled-back ring isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-finite-discrete-scheme-ring-constant]. Then R_X is an equivalence, additive, and preserves finite limits and finite colimits. The generator and closure definitions are the existing unchanged finite-comparison definitions [sk-def-localizing-closure, sk-def-sfb-constructible, def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes].

proof.text: Evaluate the internal constant-presheaf action sectionwise. The specified encoding composed with this functor is naturally the identity, by the identity underlying linear maps.

The internal-module sheafification adjunction has invertible unit on these already-sheaf underlying additive presheaves. Its counit is invertible, and the sectionwise module encoding is an equivalence. Consequently the specified constant internal realization is an equivalence.

Restriction along the inverse scheme-ring isomorphism is an equivalence. Compose these two equivalences; equivalences preserve finite limits and colimits, and preservation of binary products makes this functor additive.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteComparisonRealization_exact (X : Scheme.{u})
    (eR : Sheaf.sheafifyRingPresheaf.{u + 1, u, u + 1} (coherentTopology Profinite.{u})
      ((Functor.const Profinite.{u}ᵒᵖ).obj (RingCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} B))) ≅
        Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} B) [IsMonHom eR.hom] :
    (finiteComparisonRealization B X eR).IsEquivalence ∧
    (finiteComparisonRealization B X eR).Additive ∧
    PreservesFiniteLimits (finiteComparisonRealization B X eR) ∧
    PreservesFiniteColimits (finiteComparisonRealization B X eR)
